text:
maria: heads-up: getting a spike of 401s for org `acme-inc` on our /v1/generate route, started ~14:05 UTC. Customer reports SSO logins worked but API calls fail

devin: any repro logs?

maria: pastes from our token-verifier logs:

```
error: jwt verification failed: signature mismatch
issuer: https://sso.acme.example/
kid from token header: \"k_7Jq3\"
jwks fetch status: 200
jwks payload keys: [ {kid: \"k_7Jq3\", alg: RS256}, {kid: \"k_7Jq3\", alg: RS256, x5c: [...] } ]
note: duplicate kid entries returned by idp
```

alice: whoa duplicate kid. idP sent two keys with same kid? probably an issuer aliasing/rotation edge case where old and new issuers both present in keyset.

eli: checked APM traces: our verifier picks the first key by matching kid and then tries to verify; in ~60% of failures the first key doesn't match token sig but a later key would. library returns signature error instead of trying other keys.

maria: customer engineer said they rotated keys and also have an alias domain (https://sso.acme.example and https://auth.acme.example) both configured for same tenant. Their idp aggregates keysets and returns duplicate kid entries.

devin: repro steps I used locally:
1) create token signed by key B (kid k_7Jq3 alt)
2) mock jwks endpoint that returns key A then key B (same kid)
3) call our verify path -> fails\\n

curl mock example:
```
curl -s -X GET https://mock-jwks.local/.well-known/jwks.json
# returns {"keys": [keyA, keyB]}
```

eli: this explains intermittent nature. When idp order flips, we pass. When first key != token sig we fail.

alice: short-term: can we tweak our verifier to iterate all keys with same kid before returning signature error? That would be low-risk.

devin: agree. Code path is in verifier: we currently find key = keys.find(k => k.kid === token.kid) and try once. I'll change to filter(keys, kid) and try each. Also add a metric count "jwks.ambiguous_kid_attempts".

maria: also need support-runbook for customer. Please capture repro + mitigation so support can patch config.

support-bot: created ticket RINF-5234 and linked customer acme-inc. Steps and logs attached.

eli: long-term: the root issue is issuer aliasing + cache semantics. Our cache key is jwks_url only; but idp may serve aggregated set for multiple issuer aliases. Options:
- cache per issuer+thumbprint of jwks (requires id token `iss` verification against list)
- after a signature failure, force-refresh jwks (but risk thundering on attacks)
- require providers to avoid duplicate kids (not realistic)

alice: propose combined fix: 1) quick verifier change to try all keys with same kid (patch in next hour), 2) on signature failure trigger a background async JWKS refresh for that issuer and increment TTL backoff, 3) add a diagnostic log when duplicate kids observed to help idp debug.

devin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/verifier/pulls/992 — adds loop, metric, and a quick-cache-refresh hook (non-blocking) to avoid affecting live latency.

maria: QA plan: run system test that returns JWKS with duplicate kid ordering swapped and ensure verification succeeds for both orders, and run concurrency test with 1000 tokens to detect thundering.

eli: also found a compounding issue: our JWKS cache TTL was 5m and idp rotates every 30s during their rollout, so stale caches + duplicates made it sticky. I'll change default to 1m with jitter and make refresh-on-failure immediate but rate-limited per issuer.

devin: rolling patch to verifier staged to canary (eng-prod-canary) now. deploy-bot: started canary deployment for verifier v1.4.7-canary.

deploy-bot: canary health: OK (10/10 requests verified) for first 15 minutes. No CPU spike.

maria: emailed customer letting them know we mitigated and asking them to confirm. Also asked idp to provide canonical jwks endpoint or remove duplicate kids.

alice: follow-up items: (1) add integration test for twin-kid jwks (2) add metric/alert if duplicate-kid seen >5 in 10m (3) update runbook to include forced jwks refresh command:

```
# admin tool
 rwctl auth jwks-refresh --issuer https://sso.acme.example
```

eli: adding to backlog: de-duplication policy in cache layer (normalize by key thumbprint) and optional strict-mode that enforces unique kids across issuer.

maria: thanks team — please paste final release note when merged so I can close RINF-5234. :thumbsup:

devin: merged PR and releasing to prod in 30m. changelog: "Verifier: handle duplicate kid entries in JWKS by trying all matching keys; async JWKS refresh on verification failure; add metrics and logs."

support-bot: updated ticket RINF-5234 status -> resolved-pending-customer-confirmation

maria: customer confirmed in DM that their API calls recovered after ~10m. closing loop once prod rollout finishes.

eli: putting postmortem note in incidents channel with timeline and mitigations.

maria: great work everyone.
